description: This file implements the Widevine platform DRM interface, including constructor/destructor and decrypt methods handling decryption with handle and session ID. It interacts with the widevine::Cdm class and performs handle conversions, logging, and decryption operations.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class implementing Widevine DRM platform-specific decryption functions, including constructor, destructor, and decryption methods.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Widevine platform with a provided Cdm pointer.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor that performs cleanup for the Widevine platform.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decrypts data given a handle and a decryption batch; converts handle to a secure pointer and invokes the Cdm's decrypt method.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decrypts data with a handle, session ID, and decryption batch; similar to the above but includes session management.
